dossier.summary: Pennant Robotics builds palletizing robots for food and beverage plants, with about 140 people in Ohio and a growing list of component suppliers.
dossier.why_now: Raised a Series B in August and is hiring in finance and operations.

site.markdown:
# Pennant Robotics

Palletizing robots for food and beverage plants, built in Ohio and installed in 14 states.

## Talk to us

Tell us about your line and we will reply within a day. This form is powered by HubSpot.

careers.title: Careers at Pennant Robotics
careers.description: Engineering, operations and finance roles in Ohio.
careers.markdown:
# Careers

## Manufacturing Engineer

Own the build process for one robot family. Work is tracked in Jira, and you will write the first version of most of the tickets.

## Accounts Payable Specialist

Supplier invoices, three-way match and payment runs for a growing supplier list.
